task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick up the box with cards inside and move it away.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。机械臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架拾起内有卡片的盒子并将其移走。
